title: “AI Afterlife” as Digital Legacy: Perceptions, Expectations, and Concerns
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative human-centered study (HCI) that explores user perceptions of AI-generated agents. While it discusses ethical concerns and spiritual/cultural aspects of death and remembrance (e.g., filial piety and spiritual connections) as factors in user attitudes, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious systems, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks within the AI models themselves.
